concept: llama.cpp causal_attn flag scheduler re-reserve cost per image (PR 28751)
summary: PR 28751 was opened on 2026-09-11 and merged on 2026-09-28 as commit ed7ac35e1ee49cb70e4dfa9f0a2ce39b0a5ec4ea after 14 checks passed.

facts.text: PR 28751 was opened on 2026-09-11 and merged on 2026-09-28 as commit ed7ac35e1ee49cb70e4dfa9f0a2ce39b0a5ec4ea after 14 checks passed.
In `set_causal_attn`, ed7ac35 replaces `sched_need_reserve = true;` with a comment and a commented-out copy of the line.

The PR author found by grepping `cparams.causal_attn` in `src/` that the only read that changes tensor sizes is in `src/models/qwen4exp.cpp` lines 552-569, where it affects `blk_bias` and the size of `qsa->bias`.
am17an noted that CI runs with `GGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC`, so a model whose graph shape depends on the flag would fail those tests.

The author's `test-llama-archs` toggle test showed that master plus only the first commit aborts qwen4exp with `ggml_backend_sched_alloc_splits: unexpected graph reallocation`, and the full PR passes all 366 tests with `-DGGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC=ON`.

ggerganov wrote that disabling the `causal_attn` reserve (as in PR 28927) is fine, preferred a rewrite of the Qwen4 inference graph and memory over more changes, and then asked to keep the qwen4exp changes so CI does not break.

ddh0 reported on DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp that the graph was re-reserved before the first image, between every image and once to return to text generation, each taking about 5 seconds on their machine.
PR 28927 (dkrisman, opened 2026-09-15) made the identical change and was closed by ggerganov on 2026-09-28, the day PR 28751 merged.

PR 28927 measured each reserve at about 700 ms with `n_ctx = 262144` and two slots, and about 330 ms with `n_ctx = 131072` (allocating a 612 MiB CUDA-host compute buffer), with GPU utilization near 3% and one CPU core saturated.

PR 28927 reports on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with Gemma 4 31B Q4_K_M: a 10-frame clip at `n_ctx = 131072` went from 10.46 s to 3.18 s, a single-image embedding decode from 405 ms to 66 ms, and a 280-frame clip at `n_ctx = 262144` from 489 s to 118 s.
PR 28927 states that `tools/mtmd/mtmd-helper.cpp::scope_non_causal` disables causal attention before every image chunk and restores it afterward, and that audio chunks use the same path.
PR 28927 states that `llama_context::encode()` changes `cparams.causal_attn` around `process_ubatch()` without requesting a scheduler reserve.
PR 28927 lists as untested: audio chunks, M-RoPE vision models such as Qwen VL, CPU-only backends and `--no-mmproj-offload`.
Tag b11232 was released on 2026-09-28 and is built from commit 6f767fe ("ggml-cpu: enable tiled flash attention for non-vector-multiple head dims on x86").
A GitHub compare from ed7ac35 to b11232 lists 5 commits and 15 changed files, which means b11232 is ahead of the PR 28751 merge commit.
A GitHub compare from ed7ac35 to b11081 reports nothing to compare because ed7ac35 already contains all commits from b11081, so b11081 predates the merge.
Ollama tags v0.35.0 (pin b11081) lack the fix; v0.35.1 (pin b11232, see llama-cpp-bundled-revision-inside-ollama-release.md) includes it.
A Mac user sending several images per request to an Ollama build older than v0.35.1 pays two scheduler reserves per image; the cost is larger with a large `num_ctx`.
